Over box x in [0.9,1.1], y in [-0.1,0.1], z in [2.1,2.3]: m_x = 4yz in [-0.92,0.92] contains 0 (unusable); m_y = -4xz in [-10.12,-7.56] excludes 0 with certified distance 7.56 = 4*0.9*2.1 (strict margin verified); m_z = 12y in [-1.2,1.2] contains 0 (unusable, the old xy minor). The Y-fixed chart (xz minor) is therefore selected and the slice y=0 holds the unique root (x,z) = (1,sqrt(5)). Tangency witness (cylinder vs sphere center (2,0,0) radius 1, box x in [0.9,1.1], y in [-0.1,0.1], z in [-0.1,0.1] enclosing (1,0,0)): all three minors contain zero (m_x=4yz in [-0.04,0.04], m_y=-4xz in [-0.44,0.44], m_z=12y in [-1.2,1.2]), so no chart is certified and the box stays singular.
